results.evidence: Still no source gives section or total times for the Southwest Ridge. West McMillan trip reports give approach times to Terror Basin from about 5 to 8 hours and summit days from camp ranging from 4.5 hours to a full day, so no agreed figure exists to rebuild 7/4/4 vs 10. Would settle: a trip report timing the Southwest Ridge itself from Terror Basin camp.

New sources add further disagreement: one guide page says over 10,000 ft car-to-car on ~20 miles, another report gives 24 miles round trip with no gain, another ~19 miles with no gain. Combined with earlier figures (9,500, 10,000, 9,000, 8,868) no two independent sources agree on one figure. Would settle: two GPS-logged car-to-car totals that agree.

One report gives 4.5 hours camp to camp at a leisurely pace; others leave camp at 6:30 AM or after a 3-hour weather delay with no return time, and one earlier report describes an 11-hour day. No agreed summit-day figure exists to reconcile hours 6, schedule 8 h, note 4-5 h and timing 7/4/4 vs 10. Would settle: a second report timing camp-to-camp that agrees with the 4.5 h one.

Not clearly contradictory enough to patch; a second detailed descent description would settle it.

Car-to-car figures for the Monument + Lake Mountain trip keep disagreeing: 13,200 ft/31 mi, 12,136 ft/32.2 mi, 11,000 ft/31 mi, and ~10,000 ft for a one-day variant via a different line. All exceed gain_ft 7,567 and the day sum 9,900 but no two agree on one figure. Would settle: two agreeing GPS totals for this exact itinerary.

The schedule and waypoints imply ~4,000 ft for the Monument day, not 2,600. A club route summary gives 8 miles and 5,800 ft from camp for BOTH peaks, which does not isolate Monument's day. Changing the day would also break the itinerary total against the unresolved gain_ft. Would settle: a source stating Monument-only gain from Lake of the Woods.
